**Do not report vulnerabilities here.** Public issues are visible to everyone. Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/LabsCrypt/flowfi/security/advisories/new) as described in our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md). Anything that could be exploited must go through that private channel.

Use this template only for non-sensitive topics, such as hardening suggestions, questions about the security policy, or dependency hygiene.

## Description
A clear and concise description of the question or suggestion.

## Context
Add any other context here. Do not include exploit details, credentials, or keys.
